analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Oct 30th at US Close
key_insights: Hedge fund performance estimate at the US close on Oct 30, 2026: US markets recovered partially into the close but still finished significantly lower. Fundamental managers trimmed some losses, Quants slipped slightly further, and Multi-Strats finished flat.
Global Fundamental L/S managers were down 0.85% (-1.3 SD move) on the day, driven primarily by beta and Info Tech. They are down 3.3% MTD and up 9.3% YTD.
TMT-focused funds were down 3.1% (-2.2 SD) on the day, down 11.9% MTD and up 5.7% YTD. This is the weakest segment of the fundamental group.
Global Systematic L/S managers were down 0.7% (-1.9 SD), with losses from all regions led by Asia and Europe. Momentum, crowding and short-term signals were the main drags.
Systematic L/S managers are down 3.7% MTD, the first negative month of the year, and are still up 16% YTD.
Multi-Strats (equity portfolio, 4.5x leverage, no fees) were flat on the day and down 0.9% MTD.

The noon EST note said markets sold off broadly, led by Tech, with the NDX down more than 3%, and momentum and growth factors underperformed. Fundamental L/S was then down 1.2% (-1.8 SD) and TMT funds down 3.8% (-2.6 SD), so both recovered part of the loss into the close.
risk_factors: Beta and Info Tech exposure drove Fundamental L/S losses on the day.
Momentum, crowding and short-term signals were the main drags for systematic managers.
vol_and_positioning: Global Fundamental L/S: -0.85% on the day (-1.3 SD), -3.3% MTD, +9.3% YTD at the close. At noon EST: -1.2% (-1.8 SD), -3.6% MTD, +9% YTD.
TMT-focused funds: -3.1% (-2.2 SD) at the close, -11.9% MTD, +5.7% YTD. At noon EST: -3.8% (-2.6 SD), -12.6% MTD, +5.1% YTD.

Asia-focused funds: -1.3% (-2.3 SD) at the close, -2.3% MTD, still up 6.1% YTD. The noon note gave -1.2% (-1 SD), -9.5% MTD and +14% YTD for Asia-focused funds, which differs from the close figures for MTD and YTD.
Global Systematic L/S: -0.7% (-1.9 SD) at the close, -3.7% MTD, +16% YTD. At noon EST: -0.6% (-1.5 SD), -3.5% MTD, with gains in the US partly offsetting losses in Asia and Europe.
Multi-Strats: flat on the day, -0.9% MTD, equity portfolio at 4.5x leverage with no fees.
